PRODUCT_IDENTITY.title: String
PRODUCT_IDENTITY.product_type: String (Normalized product type: Vestido, Blusa, Pantalón, Blazer, Chaqueta, Calzas, etc.)

fields.EXPECTED_COMMERCIAL_CATEGORY: String (Taxonomy leaf node where this product type should compete)
fields.OBSERVED_COMMERCIAL_CATEGORIES: List[String] (Categories where product was physically observed)

CATEGORY_ALIGNMENT.derivation_rule: Deterministic rule: If OBSERVED_COMMERCIAL_CATEGORIES contains EXPECTED_COMMERCIAL_CATEGORY -> ALIGNED. If OBSERVED has > 1 commercial category -> MULTI_CATEGORY. If OBSERVED has categories but none match EXPECTED -> MISALIGNED. If only observed on Brand Hub or unmapped -> UNRESOLVED.
